label: Так
description: A 10-sentence usage card for так (so, this way) covering manner, intensity, and discourse uses.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Manner intensifier. 'Так' here means 'so' and intensifies the adverb 'быстро', stressing the degree of speed. It sits right before the word it amplifies, a very common spoken pattern.
Strategic focus: Manner of action. 'Так' means 'this way' and modifies the verb 'делай', pointing at how something is done. It refers back to a behaviour both speakers understand.
Strategic focus: Intensifying a predicate. 'Так' boosts the impersonal predicate 'холодно', conveying a strong degree of cold. This 'так + short adjective' frame is everyday exclamatory speech.

missions.phrase: Он говорит так тихо и спокойно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Manner with intensity. 'Так' intensifies the adverbs 'тихо' and 'спокойно', describing how he speaks. Placed before the adverbs, it adds emotional emphasis.
Strategic focus: Discourse marker. Here 'так' opens the sentence as a transition word meaning 'all right' or 'so', signalling a shift to action. It is colloquial and very common in conversation.
Strategic focus: Degree intensifier. 'Так' amplifies the predicate 'устал', expressing how tired the speaker is. This emotional 'так' is a staple of casual complaint.
Strategic focus: Pointing at a method. 'Так' means 'this way' and modifies 'сделай', specifying the exact manner. 'Именно' sharpens it to 'precisely like this'.
Strategic focus: Manner plus admiration. 'Так' intensifies the adverb 'красиво', which describes how she sings. The pairing expresses genuine admiration.
Strategic focus: Conditional reference. 'Так' stands in for a whole situation, meaning 'if that is the case'. This anaphoric use links back to what was just said.
Strategic focus: Softened degree. The frame 'не так уж' softens the following 'плохо', meaning 'not all that bad'. It is a fixed colloquial way to downplay something.
